text:
maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC — we observed repeat oscillation when multiple tenants probe simultaneously. Looking to nail down a pragmatic autoscaler probe policy that trades noisy early wins for stability. Proposal below.

jon: Saw the same in perf runs. Short probes (1-3s) cause false positives under bursty arrivals. We need a way to hedge without expensive long probes for every request.

deepa: Draft approach: three-tier probe + admission model.
- soft probe (1-5s): lightweight container, no GPU or tiny GPU-slice, validates that incoming rate is sustained for soft_duration. Does not reserve billing credits.
- warm confirm (20s): full resource reservation on a node but marked provisional; traffic can be mirrored but not full-shifted until confirm succeeds. Consumes warmup credits.
- commit window (rolling 60-120s): once confirm succeeds, cluster completes placement and promotes capacity to normal routing.

kevin: Love that. Add these safety knobs: exponential backoff per-tenant, probe concurrency cap (to avoid thundering herd), and jitter on retries. Example config: 
```
probe:
  soft_duration: 3s
  confirm_duration: 25s
  commit_window: 90s
  max_probes_per_tenant: 1
  backoff: [30s, 1m, 2m]
  jitter_frac: 0.15
```

sara: We should also define probe success signals explicitly: sustained_request_rate (over soft_duration), avg_response_latency (p50/p95), model-kv-cache-hit-rate, and allocation_stability (no OOMs/evictions). These become panels in the console.

maria: Architect question: where does the decision live? operator agent or control plane?

jon: Operator-local decision wins for latency (can admit provisional capacity quickly). Control plane must hold authoritative accounting for warmup credits and global limits. So operator makes provisional admits; control plane reconciles and enforces quotas asynchronously.

alice: Edge cases: what if confirm allocation fails due to fragmentation or node-level OOM?

deepa: Fallback hierarchy shipped with the policy: [same-model-quantized, compatible-smaller-model, alternate-region, queue-with-ttl]. Operator tries next option if confirm fails. Also mark probe with failure_reason tag for observability.

kevin: Important: confirm probes must have a hard timeout and release resources on timeout. Also we must rate-limit confirm probes cluster-wide to avoid capacity depletion during incidents.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started: autoscaler/probe-3tier-canary (tag: probe-3tier-2026-03-30). Metrics added: probe_attempts_total, probe_success_total, probe_failures_by_reason.

maria: Operational visibility asks: surface active probes and queued confirms in Console per-tenant with estimated time-to-confirm, warmup_credit_balance, and attributed probe_cost so customers see warmup spend. Add alert if probe_failure_rate > 5% over 5m.

jon: Billing note: confirm probes should be charged to tenant billing bucket (marked as warmup) and appear on invoices. Soft probes are free but limited. Add README in operator repo explaining accounting.

kevin: Test plan: synthetic bursts + correlated tenants to reproduce herd; chaos test where placement fails mid-confirm; cost regression tests to ensure probes don't explode bill. I'll add unit/integration tests for backoff/jitter behavior.

sara: I'll author dashboard panels and alert queries. Suggest panels: probe_rate_by_tenant, probe_success_rate (1m/5m), avg_confirm_time, probe_cost_1h, probe_failures_by_reason.

maria: Action items: deepa -> formalize probe schema + operator RPC surface; kevin -> implement backoff/jitter + resource-timeout; sara -> dashboard + alerts; jon -> console surface ticket; maria -> canary plan (1 week) and comms. Please tag me on PRs. :thumbsup:

alice: One policy question: do we allow tenant opt-out for warmups?

maria: Yes. Tenant config: warmup: { enabled: true, soft_only: false } default enabled. Opt-out implies higher latency SLA and no warmup credits consumed. Must be explicit.

kevin: Also add a feature flag to gate confirm probes per-cluster for fast rollback.

maria: Sounds good. If no objections I'll open the RFC PR and land the probe schema in the operator proto today. Thanks all. :rocket:
